extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking agent representation from Folio Literary (fiction, non-fiction, and children's writers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting queries, proposals, and manuscripts to Folio Literary agents, including what genres/qualities they seek and required submission materials and formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres and types sought
rubrics_metrics.description: We are aggressively seeking literary fiction; upmarket adult fiction that’s appropriate for book club discussion; and commercial fiction that features fresh voices and/or memorable characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non‑fiction preferences and author platform
rubrics_metrics.description: From narrative nonfiction and memoir writers to authors, experts, scholars, and journalists with well-researched, compelling and new ideas, we love authors who are ready and able to promote their work and expertise in all forms of media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit only completed, polished novels
rubrics_metrics.description: For Novels: Please wait until you’ve got a completed polished novel to query. Follow our Novel Query Letter Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should not query unfinished or unpolished novels; follow the agency's specific novel query-letter guidance linked on their site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non‑fiction requires a complete proposal and sample chapter
rubrics_metrics.description: For Non-Fiction: All of our agents require a complete non-fiction proposal with a sample chapter. Follow our Non-Fiction Proposal Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a full proposal (market analysis, chapter outline, platform, etc.) plus at least one sample chapter and adhere to the agency's non-fiction proposal instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials must be properly formatted and high quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Be sure that your cover letter, manuscript, and supplemental materials are properly formatted, and the best you think they can be: that means, at a minimum, double-spaced, well-proofed, well-written, and well-presented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At minimum use double-spacing, thorough proofreading, clear writing, and professional presentation for all submission materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find and target the right agent
rubrics_metrics.description: Review all Folio agents here to find the right agent for your project. Once you have selected the right agent for your project, follow the submission guidelines listed on the individual agent’s page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match your project to an agent's stated interests and strictly follow that agent's individual submission instructions (format, materials, subject line, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not submit simultaneously to more than one Folio Agent
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not submit simultaneously to more than one Folio Agent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit only to a single Folio agent at a time to avoid internal simultaneous submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact the agency about one project at a time
rubrics_metrics.description: Please contact us about one project at a time. You may have a drawer full of fabulous yet-to-be-published manuscripts, but only tell us about the one you feel is the most polished, the most ready to go.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit queries to your single strongest, most polished project rather than multiple projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check agent submission status (open/closed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note, some of our agents are currently closed to submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify on each agent's page whether they are accepting submissions before sending material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response expectations and resubmission policy within the agency
rubrics_metrics.description: All agents will read your queries as soon as possible. Most Folio agents will respond to let you know of their interest or to inform you of their decision not to pursue representation. If you do not hear back from the individual agent, please understand that the sheer volume of queries can be overwhelming and on occasion, it’s simply not possible to send a personal response declining representation in every case. Generally, if an agent at Folio declines a manuscript, we felt it wasn’t a fit for any of the agents at the agency. That said, if an author feels strongly that another Folio agent should have the chance to review the author’s submission, please let the second agent know that the author has already submitted the project to other agents within Folio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect possible non-response due to volume; a decline often indicates the project may not fit the agency broadly, but authors may request another Folio agent to review, disclosing prior internal submission.
